# See https://aka.ms/customizecontainer to learn how to customize your debug container and how Visual Studio uses this Dockerfile to build your images for faster debugging.

# This stage is used when running from VS in fast mode (Default for Debug configuration)
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0 AS base
USER $APP_UID
WORKDIR /app
EXPOSE 8080
EXPOSE 8081


# This stage is used to build the service project
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0 AS build
ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
WORKDIR /src
COPY ["Directory.Build.props", "."]
COPY ["src/Bovis.Web/Bovis.Web.csproj", "src/Bovis.Web/"]
COPY ["src/BohrIS/Bovis.Web.Bohris/Bovis.Web.Bohris.csproj", "src/BohrIS/Bovis.Web.Bohris/"]
COPY ["src/BohrIS/Bovis.Services.Bohris/Bovis.Services.Bohris.csproj", "src/BohrIS/Bovis.Services.Bohris/"]
COPY ["src/Bovis.Interfaces/Bovis.Interfaces.csproj", "src/Bovis.Interfaces/"]
COPY ["src/Bovis.Services/Bovis.Services.csproj", "src/Bovis.Services/"]
COPY ["src/Bovis.Logging/Bovis.Logging.csproj", "src/Bovis.Logging/"]
COPY ["src/BohrIS/Bovis.Data.Bohris/Bovis.Data.Bohris.csproj", "src/BohrIS/Bovis.Data.Bohris/"]
COPY ["src/Bovis.Data/Bovis.Data.csproj", "src/Bovis.Data/"]
COPY ["src/DbTools/DbUrl/DbUrl.csproj", "src/DbTools/DbUrl/"]
COPY ["src/LBEG/Bovis.Web.LBEG/Bovis.Web.LBEG.csproj", "src/LBEG/Bovis.Web.LBEG/"]
COPY ["src/LBEG/Bovis.Data.LBEG/Bovis.Data.LBEG.csproj", "src/LBEG/Bovis.Data.LBEG/"]
COPY ["src/LBEG/Bovis.Services.LBEG/Bovis.Services.LBEG.csproj", "src/LBEG/Bovis.Services.LBEG/"]
COPY ["src/Bovis.Storage/Bovis.Storage.csproj", "src/Bovis.Storage/"]
COPY ["src/DbTools/DbDrivers/DbDrivers.csproj", "src/DbTools/DbDrivers/"]
RUN dotnet restore "./src/Bovis.Web/Bovis.Web.csproj"
COPY . .
WORKDIR "/src/src/Bovis.Web"
RUN dotnet build "./Bovis.Web.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/build

# This stage is used to publish the service project to be copied to the final stage
FROM build AS publish
ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
RUN dotnet publish "./Bovis.Web.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false

# This stage is used in production or when running from VS in regular mode (Default when not using the Debug configuration)
FROM base AS final
WORKDIR /app
USER root
RUN apt update && apt install -y fontconfig micro nano
USER $APP_UID
COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Bovis.Web.dll"]=== ci ===
